title: Extraction evaluation in rwb-agent: service login, document-type owner, admin operation set, route path and score read path
source: Legacy story RWB-E1-060; Template and Rules v1 §R3 and §R5.5; FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.4 to A2.6; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1, T3.2 and T-A; Ownership Map
section: §3 Preconditions; §12 Contract; §13 Solution plan; §15 Screens and states
description: The sources leave five values for this story open: (1) the login name of the rwb-agent service under DP-02; (2) the owner of LOV-DOC-TYPE and the six document types, which the legacy story section 13 names as P4 while DP-07 and the R-PREC default ruling give reference data to P3 rwb-case; (3) the exact admin operation set of the story, since the TSD lists an evaluation report operation (API-P10-008) and the configuration operations that the legacy story does not use; (4) the path of the gateway-bff route in front of the three admin reads; (5) the read path of the score rows and the proposal for the monitoring dashboard of RWB-E1-063, which no source names outside the CSV export of the evaluation read. The story keeps the legacy behaviour and settles each value as an assumption.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E1-060 section 3 (preconditions), section 12 (the four operations and the in-process P5 interfaces) and section 13 ('Document types come from LOV-DOC-TYPE through P4'); Template and Rules v1 §R3 default rulings and §R5.5 DP-02, DP-07 and DP-19; FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.4, A2.5 and A2.6; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T-A.1 (API-P10-005 to API-P10-008) and T3.1; Ownership Map api rows POST /admin/agent-samples, POST /admin/agent-evaluations and GET /admin/agent-evaluations under P10 and GET /admin/lists/{listCode} under P3
proposed: Keep the legacy behaviour; name the login 'the rwb-agent login (DP-02)', read LOV-DOC-TYPE from the rwb-case reference-data contract, keep the three legacy admin operations on /api/recovery/agent/v1 and leave the report and configuration operations with RWB-P10-E1058-APP, route the reads through gateway-bff on the same admin path, and read the scores only through the evaluation read; confirm in the verification loop

title: RWB-E8-003 in rwb-agent: the champion/challenger request fields, the comparison measure and its policy row, the P1 score-fact read, the version of a score row, the proposal shape, the migration number, the evaluation-run name and the requirement row are not specified
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E8-003); WP B-P10-04; FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.5 and A2.14; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1, T3.2, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 16, 41, 42 and 43; Ownership Map v1; Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Program v4; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3
description: Eight values the rwb-agent slice needs are absent or unresolved in the sources. (1) The two version labels of a champion and challenger pair have no published field names: API-P10-006 carries an AgentEvaluationRequest with no field list in any source, so the request extension is a backward-compatible pair of labels whose names are agreed at the contract freeze. (2) The comparison measure, the sample floor below which a comparison is not read and the decision threshold that names a winner have no row and no value: TSD P10 v2 T3.1 gives agent_policy only timeout_seconds (DF-AGT-012), confidence_floor (DF-AGT-011) and daily_cost_cap_thb (DF-AGT-013), and no source gives a statistical test, a sample floor or a threshold. (3) The read path of the ACE score facts is not given: no rwb-source-data operation returns v_ace_score, and Architecture v5 slide 15 lists only /customers/{id}, /accounts/{id}, /collateral/{id}, /payments?accountId=, /freshness and POST /business-days/{date}/ready. (4) agent_evaluation has no column that names the version a score row belongs to (DF-AGT-086 to DF-AGT-096) and agent_evaluation_run.policy_version and model_version are single-valued (DF-AGT-074, DF-AGT-076), so the per-version score rows are tied to their version by the run's proposal instead of by a column. (5) The JSON field names inside agent_evaluation_run.proposal (DF-AGT-084) are not specified for the pair, the measure, the per-version value and the winner. (6) The Flyway file number of a rwb_agent migration is not given by any source. (7) The name of the evaluation run that carries the comparison step is not given: Architecture v5 slide 16 names only AgentRunWorkflow, and API-P10-006 to API-P10-008 start the harness without naming its orchestration. (8) The legacy story carries no requirement ID and the Program BRD v4 holds no requirement row for FEAT-AGT-14, which appears only in the Epic 3 to 8 feature table, row E8 P10. One difference of source is recorded here too: the legacy permission table grants Platform administration R to six roles while TSD P10 T-A.1 declares Rules and parameters C, R and R on API-P10-006, API-P10-007 and API-P10-008; under the source precedence the TSD wins and the story uses Rules and parameters. The story is written with the pair in the request extension, the measure and the threshold as policy rows, the score facts through the P1 contract, the winner on proposal, and the missing values named as placeholders.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E8-003 section 'Endpoints': 'None. The work runs as a service or a scheduled job inside the recovery module.'; its permission table grants Platform administration R to RW-COE, RW-DATASTEW, RW-AUDIT, RW-COMPLY, RW-PLATADM and RW-SECADM; its Data table lists decision_log_entry, v_ace_score and rule_row only; FSD P10 v3 A2.14 gives one AC-P10-014-01 with no field beyond the agent_policy field catalog, and A2.5 gives AC-EXC-P10-005-05 and AC-EXC-P10-005-06 for the empty sample and the running evaluation; TSD P10 v2 T-A.2 API-P10-006 lists 'Request: AgentEvaluationRequest' with no field detail and API-P10-007 'as JSON or CSV'; TSD P10 v2 T3.1 gives agent_evaluation without a version or policy column and agent_evaluation_run with the single-valued policy_version, model_version and the jsonb proposal; Architecture v5 slide 15 lists the rwb-source-data REST operations and none of them is a score read; Architecture v5 slide 16 names AgentRunWorkflow only; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line for E8 P10 FEAT-AGT-14 is the only row of the feature in the extracts and the Program BRD v4 carries no requirement for it
proposed: Agree the two label fields of AgentEvaluationRequest and the proposal shape with RWB-P10-E1058-CON; add the comparison measure, the sample floor and the decision threshold as rows of the policy version with the RW-COE and RW-RISK owners; publish the v_ace_score read as one GET operation of the rwb-source-data contract with the subject set and the business date as parameters; settle the rwb_agent migration number with the DB stories; name the evaluation run in the harness contract; and add the requirement row for FEAT-AGT-14 to the Epic 8 BRD

title: Drift thresholds, the drift window, the segment composition, the score-fact read path and the requirement ID are not fixed by any source
source: RWB-E3-031 sections 1 to 16; FSD P10 v3 A2.13 (FEAT-AGT-13) and A2.6 (AC-EXC-P10-006-03 and AC-EXC-P10-006-04); TSD P10 v2 T3.1 (DF-AGT-001 to DF-AGT-111) and T3.2; Architecture v5 slides 16, 41 and 44; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row E3, P10, FEAT-AGT-13; Business Requirements Program v4 (no drift match, no FEAT-AGT match); ownership map (agent_alert, agent_run, agent_evaluation, agent_evaluation_run, agent_policy owner P10; decision_log_entry owner P7; assignment and task owner P3; GET /admin/agent-runs and GET /admin/agent-metrics owner P10)
section: 3. Preconditions; 7. Acceptance criteria AC3 to AC10; 10. Authority; 11. Data; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.6 Schedules; 13. Configuration and migrations; 18. Traceability
description: The legacy story and its module specifications name the behaviour of the drift check but none of the values it needs. (1) The value of each drift and calibration threshold, the measure each policy version watches and the minimum sample are not in any source, so they are rows of agent_policy.watch_measures (DF-AGT-019) and their keys and literals are left open. (2) The window of the check is only implied by FSD A2.6 AC-EXC-P10-006-04 (the week to 2026-12-14) and no source names the cadence, which the Arch v5 job map does not carry for the agent monitor (JOB-15 in slide 44 is the reporting extract of rwb-reporting). (3) The composition of agent_alert.segment is not defined anywhere, although the column is varchar(30) and both agent_run and agent_policy carry a product group and a region. (4) The operation and data product by which the ACE score facts of v_ace_score (DF-ACE-270 to DF-ACE-279) are read from rwb-source-data is not specified. (5) No source states what happens when the policy version in force has no review_date (DF-AGT-016, not required), while the legacy criterion requires a date on the decision. (6) The Flyway number of any migration that adds agent_alert if the baseline does not carry it is not specified. (7) The legacy permission list gives Platform administration R to six roles and not to RW-RISK, while FSD A2.6 and A2.13 name the risk and model risk officer as the primary user. (8) The name of the rwb-agent login is not in any source. (9) The legacy story carries no requirement ID and no BRD in the extracts carries FEAT-AGT-13, so section 18 traces the feature and no requirement.
evidence: FSD P10 v3 A2.13 gives one criterion with the words 'the data and the rules it needs are in place' and 'the result is recorded with its rule version', and BR-P10-013 only forbids a value in code; TSD P10 v2 T3.1 lists the agent_alert fields with no threshold column and T3.2 lists the two alert types; FSD A2.6 AC-ALT-P10-006-01 gives a cost alert with measured 2,310.5000 and threshold 2,000 but no drift threshold, and AC-EXC-P10-006-04 gives 12 feedback entries in the week to 2026-12-14 as 'not enough feedback' without the minimum; Architecture v5 slide 16 names the rwb-agent OUT lines and no drift read, and slide 44 names no agent-monitor job; the ownership map names the tables and the two monitor operations without payloads; the Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row names FEAT-AGT-13 with no requirement ID.
area: Agent runtime / drift monitoring and alerting
owner_role: Service owner of rwb-agent with the Center of Excellence analyst and the service owner of rwb-source-data
proposed: Load the drift threshold, the watched measure and the minimum sample as rows of the policy version in force; confirm the week-to-business-date window with the monitor story; publish the segment composition and the score-fact operation in the rwb-agent and rwb-source-data contracts before the wave 2 exit; settle the review-date rule and the RW-RISK right with rwb-access.
